control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: danger tagging failure on P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on P-4102, ACC-4102 and M-4102 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 18 September 2006 an incident occurred on P-4102, ACC-4102 and M-4102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
